role_and_message.evidence: The same framework spans three PDE problems, two programming arms, the lab community and its four iteration phases, then two example discovered operator programs.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All three PDE rows and five source field/surface tiles, both arms, the full illustrative lab grid, planner/worker/reviewer/lifecycle loop, Darcy operator and Allen-Cahn operator remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: The 16 labs x16 iterations and single-lab x256 same-budget statements, up to3 repairs, 0.21M parameter counts, 3x3/5x5/7x7 kernels, softmax(x,y), F/A/W/R/T/G/S legend and relative L2 metric retain source values.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Planner program feeds numerical training, error/code feeds reviewer, and critique/inspirations loop back. Failure feedback returns toward planning. The Darcy grid weights convolution branches through softmax; Allen-Cahn F to A splits S/W, sums, then R to G, as in the original.

visual_encodings.evidence: Citation arrows point toward the starred most-cited lab; plus denotes founding and crosses removal. The separate held-out-retraining arrow remains independent of the star, avoiding an unsupported equivalence between most-cited and evaluation winner.

examples_and_data.evidence: All five PDE example tiles were independently verified as exact native 1:1 RGB copies of source regions, including recorded pixel hashes. Program diagrams remain schematic rather than empirical curves.

unsupported_additions.evidence: No new performance claim is added. Held-out random seed retraining, different winners by problem and no universal winner are original statements supported by the caption and Method Sections 4-5.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All sections, restored scientific fields, complete operator branches, legend, parameters and bottom same-budget ablation text are visible.

remaining_limitations: The illustrative lab grid retains the source schematic arrangement including lifecycle/new/removed icons; the experimental configuration is conveyed by its unchanged 16-lab label. All five scientific tiles are exact native pixels. This audit does not validate reported empirical findings.
caption:
Figure 1: The neural operator AI scientific community: the three problems and the two arms (left), a
community of 16 labs and the four phases of each iteration inside a lab (center), and two discovered
programs (right). Every winning program is retrained on held-out random seeds before it is compared
with other models.
